stepIntro.classifier: Choose how each request is assigned a complexity tier. Switching later keeps the other classifier's settings, including your reference phrases.

classifierChoice.decisionDescription: A decision model judges the complexity of each request and picks the tier whose definition, signals, and examples fit it best. Use Typesafe Jev, OpenAI's decision models, Cloudflare Clef, or another provider that serves decision models. No phrases to write or maintain.
classifierChoice.semanticDescription: Matches each request against reference phrases you write for each tier, through an embedding model you choose. You decide exactly what each tier means.

phrases.heading: Phrase to Tier Mapping
phrases.callout: The added reference phrases are examples to help you get started. We recommend auditing, refining and adding your own reference phrases.
phrases.placeholder: Type a reference phrase and press Enter

simple.label: Simple
simple.description: Requests to route to your cheapest, fastest model.

medium.label: Medium
medium.description: Requests that need more capability than your cheapest model, but not your most capable.

complex.label: Complex
complex.description: Requests that justify your most capable model.

warnings.reembedAll: Saving will embed all {{count}} reference phrases through the selected provider. Changing the provider or model invalidates every stored vector, so the whole list is embedded again. This uses embedding tokens and may take a short time.
warnings.newPhrase_one: Saving will embed {{count}} new reference phrase through the selected provider. The other {{reused}} reuse the embeddings this gateway already holds.
warnings.newPhrase_other: Saving will embed {{count}} new reference phrases through the selected provider. The other {{reused}} reuse the embeddings this gateway already holds.
warnings.footerDecisionBlocked: The decision model is the fallback, and it needs a working provider before this can be saved.
warnings.classifierChanged: Classifier changed to {{classifier}}. Not saved yet.
warnings.footerDecisionBlockedNeedsConfig: The decision model needs a working provider before this can be saved. See Edit model configuration.

restoreDialog.title: Restore defaults
restoreDialog.description: This will replace the phrase to tier mapping with the default reference phrases. Your current phrases will be lost and this action cannot be undone. Your embedding configuration is kept, so classification keeps running and the restored phrases are embedded through the configured provider straight away.

errors.saveFailed: Couldn’t save the Complexity Router configuration. {{error}}
errors.loadFailed: Couldn’t load the Complexity Router configuration.
errors.noConfig: No complexity router configuration is available.

sessionCard.label: Session-aware routing
sessionCard.description: Keep each session at its highest complexity tier for 24 hours of inactivity. Harder turns can move up; easier turns stay put to reduce model changes. Requests without a session ID route independently.

llmPrompt.title: Fallback Classification Prompt
llmPrompt.description: Customize the classification model's system prompt; a default is provided when no phrase matches.
llmPrompt.helper: Leave blank to use default guidance. Bifrost always appends a fixed response-format section (the tier names and the JSON answer contract), so edits here refine what the tiers mean but cannot break routing.

decisionGuidance.note: We recommend starting with these defaults, then refining them to match what each tier means for you.
decisionGuidance.usage: Each tier's definition, signals and examples are sent to the decision model with every request.
decisionGuidance.editTooltip: Describe what makes a request {{tier}}. The decision model uses this to decide which requests belong in this tier.
decisionGuidance.unavailable: This gateway did not return its default guidance, so it cannot be edited here. The decision model keeps using the saved or shipped guidance.
decisionGuidance.fallbackDescription: Used by the decision model when no reference phrase matches.

signals.label: Signals
signals.placeholder: Type a signal and press Enter
signals.tooltip: What makes a request belong in this tier: the knowledge, reasoning, or kind of work it needs.

examples.label: Examples
examples.placeholder: Type an example and press Enter
examples.tooltip: Sample requests that belong in this tier, showing what the signals look like in practice. Write them as concrete tasks.

decisionFields.providerTooltip: Typesafe or OpenRouter for Jev, OpenAI or a custom provider with base format OpenAI for OpenAI's decision models, or a custom provider with base format Typesafe serving Laya, Nimble, or Clef.
decisionFields.noProviderYet: No provider serves decision models yet.
decisionFields.modelTooltip: The model the provider runs for each classification.
decisionFields.noOpenAIModels: This provider lists no OpenAI decision models
decisionFields.searchJev: Search or type a Jev model…
decisionFields.clefSetBy: Set by this provider’s Cloudflare URL.
decisionFields.maxMessagesTooltip: User messages sent to the decision model in addition to the current request, oldest to newest. Widening this lets a short follow-up like “and make it faster” inherit earlier intent, but sends more input tokens per request. Assistant replies are never sent. Defaults to 1.
decisionFields.timeoutTooltip: Maximum wait for the decision model's API call. If the limit is exceeded, we skip and fall back to the original request model. Typesafe Jev typically responds in about 600 - 800 ms.
decisionFields.noDecisionModels: This provider lists no decision models

missing.message: The decision model runs through the {{provider}} provider, and it is not set up yet.

failing.message: The {{provider}} provider is failing its checks, so decision-model calls will fail. Check its key and settings.

noEnabledKey.message: The {{provider}} provider has no enabled key, so decision-model calls will fail.

summary.notConfiguredSelected: No embedding provider is selected, so requests carry no complexity tier and rules targeting one never match.
summary.notConfiguredNoProviders: No embedding-capable provider is configured, so requests carry no complexity tier and rules targeting one never match.
summary.notSaved: Save this configuration to embed the reference phrases and activate classification.
summary.warming: Embedding the reference phrases. Classification starts once every phrase is loaded.
summary.unavailable: Bifrost could not report whether the saved classifier is ready. Routing may still be working.

statusBadge.servingPrevious: The previous reference phrases are still serving requests while this generation prepares. Routing is unaffected.
statusBadge.unsaved: The saved classifier is still serving. Save to prepare and activate these phrase or model changes.
statusBadge.refreshFailed: The latest status check failed. Showing the last known classifier state.

embedded.label: Embedded
embedded.tooltip: Keeps phrase vectors in Bifrost's own memory. No infrastructure to run, but every restart re-embeds them.

vector_store.label: Vector Store
vector_store.tooltip: Keeps phrase vectors in the vector store configured for Bifrost, so they survive restarts. Falls back to Embedded if no vector store is available.

vectorStore.notConnected: No vector store is connected, so phrases stay in the embedded store until one is configured.

none.label: None
none.description: A request matching no phrase confidently carries no tier, and rules referencing complexity_tier do not match it.

llm.label: LLM classifier
llm.description: A chat model names the tier instead. Slower and costlier than an embedding, but only unmatched requests pay for it.

decision.label: Decision model
decision.description: A decision model names the tier when semantic matching has no result, using the same tier guidance as when it is the primary classifier.

embeddingSheet.title: Embedding configuration
embeddingSheet.description: The model that embeds requests and reference phrases. API keys are inherited from the provider's main configuration.
embeddingSheet.noProviders: No embedding-capable provider is configured. There is nothing to select here until one exists.
embeddingSheet.savedProviderUnavailable: {{provider}} is saved here but has no enabled key, so it cannot embed anything. Re-enable a key for it, or select another provider below.
embeddingSheet.requiredCallout: Pick an embedding provider and model to configure the rest. Until then the classifier is off and only the phrase lists are saved.
embeddingSheet.searchEmbedModel: Search or type an embedding model…
embeddingSheet.minSimilarityHelp: Between 0 and 1. How close the nearest phrase must be before its tier is used.
embeddingSheet.minSimilarityWarning: Lower values raise the risk of false positives.
embeddingSheet.maxEmbedTooltip: The most recent user messages are joined oldest to newest and embedded as one text. Widening this lets a short follow-up like “and make it faster” inherit earlier intent, but dilutes the latest message and embeds more tokens. System prompts and assistant replies are never embedded.
embeddingSheet.timeoutTooltip: Maximum wait for the embedding call, including provider queue and response time. On timeout, the configured fallback applies.
embeddingSheet.fallbackClassifierTip: This configures the model and its request settings only. The classification prompt itself is edited on the Complexity Router page, in the Fallback Classification Prompt section below the phrase lists.
embeddingSheet.fallbackClassifierDescription: This model assigns a complexity tier when no reference phrase matches confidently. API keys come from the provider's main configuration.
embeddingSheet.latencyCallout: Pick a small, fast model. The timeout limits how long classification can delay the request. If it times out, complexity routing is skipped for that request.
embeddingSheet.noLLMProviders: No provider with an enabled key is configured. There is nothing to select here until one exists.
embeddingSheet.savedLLMProviderUnavailable: {{provider}} is saved here but has no enabled key, so it cannot classify anything. Re-enable a key for it, or select another provider below.
embeddingSheet.llmRequiredCallout: Pick a provider and model to configure the rest. Until then the LLM classifier cannot run.
embeddingSheet.searchChatModel: Search or type a chat model…
embeddingSheet.llmTimeoutTooltip: Ceiling on the classification completion, which runs inline on the request path. Exceeding it skips complexity tier based routing for that request.
embeddingSheet.maxSendTooltip: The most recent user messages are sent to the classifier oldest to newest. Widening this lets a short follow-up like “and make it faster” inherit earlier intent, but sends more input tokens per request. System prompts and assistant replies are never sent.
embeddingSheet.budgetEmbedTooltip: Bills each classification embedding to the same budgets as the request that triggered it, and warmup embeddings to the provider and model budgets. Cost is always reported to telemetry either way.
embeddingSheet.budgetClassifyTooltip: Bills each classification completion to the same budgets as the request that triggered it. Cost is always reported to telemetry either way.

decisionSheet.title: Model configuration
decisionSheet.description: Which decision model classifies requests, how much conversation it sees, and how long it may take. Credentials come from its provider.
